gap: No result ChatGPT got states what the whole 10,000 mAh built-in-cable set costs at the makers' stores today: Anker's own page sells the Nano 10K 45W retractable (A1638) at $45.99, not the $59.99 ChatGPT showed, and INIU's store sells the Pawsible Slim 10K 45W at $26.99, not $24.99, so the step up to the 2.3 ft retractable cable is $19, not $35.
standout_why: Compared against Talk Android (cited), PopSci (cited), Anker's blog (cited), itechguides, Pickstead and powerbank-online. Talk Android gives list prices only ($29.99 INIU, $54.99 UGREEN Nexode Pro, no A1638 row) and says street prices may be lower. PopSci has the Zolo at $29.99 and the Fusion at $52.99 as of Oct 21, which still match, but no 45 W model. Anker's blog and powerbank-online publish no prices. itechguides lists the Nano 10K 45W with no price, though it already has its shared-output drop. Pickstead prices a different model (A1259, 30 W, $49.99). TechRadar's body would not load and Best Buy timed out, so those two cited pages are unread. Limits: the $45.99 is a sale price with no end date shown, and I could not re-read the UGREEN and Baseus rows (HTTP 429 all session, including a delayed retry).
decides: Confirms the INIU Pawsible Slim as the value pick at $26.99 among the stores I read. It changes the premium verdict: at $45.99 the Anker Nano 45W retractable, the one row we already hold a record for, costs $19 more than the INIU rather than $35, and it undercuts both the 30 W Anker Fusion ($52.99) and Pickstead's Sept 11 price for the 30 W Nano A1259 ($49.99). The Nano still loses to the INIU on price and on its 22.5 W shared cap. The Zolo at $29.99 loses outright: 30 W for $3 more than INIU's 45 W. Whether the UGREEN Nexode Pro or Baseus FC11 10K places in the top three depends on the $35.99 prices in the brief, which I did not re-read; our record for the Nano links Amazon, whose price I also could not read.
